_comment: Illustrative KeeperHub workflow for the EdgeScout Agent Economy entry. Mirrors what EdgeScout's POST /api/keeperhub does via the KeeperHub MCP execute_transfer tool: a deterministic signal triggers a capped, idempotency-keyed testnet USDC transfer on Base Sepolia. Argument names follow KeeperHub's documented MCP schema (chain_id as numeric string, human-readable amount, idempotency_key). Replace the placeholder values with real ones before importing into the KeeperHub builder.
name: EdgeScout deterministic signal -> testnet USDC transfer
description: EdgeScout's 1/4-Kelly model sizes an event-contract position; this workflow executes the mirror transfer on Base Sepolia and records the transaction link.

trigger.description: POST /api/keeperhub from the EdgeScout dashboard (or any caller) with the sized stake.

amount.description: Stake in USDC as a human-readable two-decimal string, capped by KEEPERHUB_MAX_STAKE_USD

recipient.description: 0x40-hex destination address (the org's own wallet in this demo)

idempotencyKey.description: Derived from the EdgeScout ledger entry id and mode (edgescout-<entryId>-<mode>); prevents double-spend on retry

steps.description: Simulation preflight; must report success and no revert before anything broadcasts.
Broadcast the transfer; the org wallet pays, KeeperHub signs.
EdgeScout persists the execution into its paper ledger (entry.keeperhub) so the dashboard and every later audit show the tx link next to the position.
